data.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests for updated process_status() in plugins/dso/scripts/ticket_reducer/_processors.py. Tests must be RED before T13 implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: incoming STATUS event has current_status != state[status] (fork condition); When: process_status() called; Then: applies lexical UUID tie-break (lower parent_status_uuid string value wins)
- Given: fork resolved with winner event; When: state inspected; Then: state[status] == winner's target status
- Given: fork resolved; When: stderr captured; Then: contains 'PARENT_CHAIN_FORK_RESOLVED source=<winner-uuid> dropped=<loser-uuid> target_status=<winner-target>'
- Given: fork resolved; When: state inspected; Then: state does NOT contain 'conflicts' key (removed entirely)
- Given: non-conflicting STATUS event (current_status matches state[status]); When: process_status() called; Then: state[status] updated normally, no fork log emitted

Semantic clarification:
- dropped=<loser-uuid> is a single UUID string (the UUID filename of the discarded event, without .json extension)
- Lexical comparison: Python string sort on parent_status_uuid values; lower sorts first = wins

Test file: tests/unit/test_processors.py (add new test functions)
Story DD coverage: SC7 (fork detection + tie-break)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: RED: tests for fork detection and lexical tie-break in _processors.py process_status
